metadata.title: CHGIS V6 1911: v6_1911_cnty_pgn_gbk.zip
metadata.citation: "CHGIS Version 6." (c) Fairbank Center for Chinese Studies and the Institute for Chinese Historical Geography at Fudan University, Dec 2016.
metadata.transformation: Inverse of unnnamed (Gauss Kruger) + Ballpark geographic offset from Xian 1980 to WGS 84 (with axis order normalized for visualization)
metadata.yearBasis: Official dataset title and filename; original date fields are retained.
metadata.warning: 官方文件标为 1911 年，但 2 个区域的原始 BEG_YR / END_YR 字段与该年冲突（[(1146, 1146), (3822, 3822)]）；异常原值已保留，年份尚未核实。
